connect_called_bug.gd.why: calls the handler immediately and connects its return value (null) instead of the Callable

missing_delta_bug.gd.why: movement not scaled by delta: speed depends on the physics tick rate

node_in_init_bug.gd.why: $Label is resolved in _init, before the node is in the tree: label is null and .text crashes

yield_godot3_bug.gd.why: yield() is Godot 3 syntax; Godot 4 uses await and this does not parse

off_by_one_bug.gd.why: off by one: idx == size() passes the guard and reads past the end

int_division_bug.gd.why: integer division: 30 / 100 is 0, so the health bar ratio is always 0 until full

variant_infer_bug.gd.why: := infers from a Variant return, which Godot 4.3 treats as a hard error (the repo's export gate rejects it)

missing_arg_bug.gd.why: take_damage() is called without its required argument

erase_while_iterating_bug.gd.why: erasing from the array being iterated skips the element after each removal

signal_typo_bug.gd.why: the signal name is misspelled, so nothing listening to health_changed is ever notified (and Godot logs an error)

timer_before_tree_bug.gd.why: Timer.start() before the timer is in the tree fails ("Timer was not added to the SceneTree")

change_scene_godot3_bug.gd.why: change_scene() was removed in Godot 4; it is change_scene_to_file()
